title: Manager, Partnerships, Climate & Food Systems (2-year contract)
description:
About WWF
  
  
WWF-Singapore World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries. WWF Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key conservation areas, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, marine conservation, and sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the community, businesses, and governments. For more information, please visit wwf.sg.
  
  
Overview
  
  
WWF-Singapore is seeking a Partnerships Manager to develop and manage strategic partnerships for its Climate Finance programmes, with a primary focus on its Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.
  
  
The role will identify, onboard and steward partners across the private sector, financial institutions, government, philanthropy and other organisations, helping to build a strong coalition that can mobilise finance and collective action for climate-resilient and low-carbon food systems across Southeast Asia.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Partnership Development & Onboarding
  
  
Identify and engage prospective partners for the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.
  
  
Develop compelling partnership propositions, proposals and engagement materials.
  
  
Lead prospective partners from initial engagement through onboarding and formalisation of partnerships.
  
  
Identify opportunities for partners to contribute through finance, technical expertise, market access, procurement and other forms of collaboration.
  
  
2. Partner Stewardship
  
  
Manage relationships with a portfolio of partners and serve as their primary WWF point of contact.
  
  
Maintain regular engagement with partners and identify opportunities to deepen collaboration.
  
  
Coordinate with WWF programme and technical teams to ensure effective delivery of partnership commitments.
  
  
Prepare partnership updates, reports and briefings as required.
  
  
3. Coalition Development & Engagement
  
  
Support the growth and development of the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition as an effective regional multi-stakeholder platform.
  
  
Engage coalition members and facilitate collaboration across businesses, financial institutions, governments, technical organisations and civil society.
  
  
Coordinate coalition meetings, roundtables, workshops and other partner engagements.
  
  
Identify opportunities for joint initiatives that can mobilise finance and scale climate-resilient and low-carbon agriculture.
  
  
4. Programme Development
  
  
Support the development of sustainable food programmes and related carbon finance programmes.
  
  
Represent WWF-Singapore at relevant external engagements and industry forums.
  
  
Qualifications & Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, International Relations, Finance or a related field.
  
  
Minimum 5 years' experience in partnerships, business development, sustainability, programme development or stakeholder engagement.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to develop and manage relationships with corporate, financial, government or institutional partners.
  
  
Strong communication, relationship-management and project-management skills.
  
  
Experience in sustainable agriculture, food systems, climate finance or carbon markets would be advantageous.
  
  
Experience working in Southeast Asia would be an advantage.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
Join WWF-Singapore to build partnerships that mobilise finance and collective action for climate, nature and communities. You will work with leading organisations across the region to help scale climate-resilient and sustainable food systems across Southeast Asia.
  
  
Interested applicants are encouraged to complete the online application form -
  
  
https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/6ak1TscikC

description:
**Job Title:** Sustainability Manager
  
  
Job Description & Requirements
  
  
We are seeking a Sustainability Manager to improve sustainability and operational efficiency across our café and food-service operations. The role focuses on reducing food waste, improving resource usage, introducing practical digital solutions and supporting staff in adopting sustainable practices.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
1. Sustainable Food Operations &Waste Management
  
  
Review food preparation, storage and service practices to identify sources of food waste, ingredient wastage and avoidable resource consumption.
  
  
Develop practical waste-reduction approaches for ingredients, food preparation and day-to-day café operations while maintaining food quality and service standards.
  
  
Establish procedures for identifying, recording and managing food waste and material wastage across relevant operational areas.
  
  
Coordinate with kitchen and operations teams to incorporate sustainable practices into daily food-service activities.
  
  
Evaluate the operational effectiveness of waste-reduction measures and identify areas requiring further attention.
  
  
2. Process Innovation & DigitalSolutions
  
  
Research and assess digital tools, technologies and process solutions relevant to food-service sustainability and operational efficiency.
  
  
Evaluate potential applications of technology for areas such as inventory management, waste tracking, resource monitoring and operational workflow.
  
  
Support the selection and introduction of suitable digital solutions based on operational requirements, usability and business needs.
  
  
Develop revised workflows to incorporate newly adopted technologies or process solutions into daily operations.
  
  
Document technology-enabled processes and operating requirements for relevant users.
  
  
3. Sustainability Data &Performance Analysis
  
  
Establish data collection methods for sustainability-related activities, including food waste, ingredient usage, packaging consumption and resource utilisation.
  
  
Consolidate and analyse operational data to identify trends, patterns, variances and areas of inefficiency.
  
  
Develop sustainability and operational KPIs to measure resource utilisation, waste reduction and the outcomes of improvement initiatives.
  
  
Prepare periodic data analysis and reports to provide Management with visibility of sustainability performance.
  
  
Translate analytical findings into evidence-based recommendations for operational planning and sustainability decision-making.
  
  
4. Sustainable Packaging &Resource Solutions
  
  
Review the suitability of existing takeaway, food-service and packaging materials from environmental, operational and cost perspectives.
  
  
Research and assess alternative packaging materials and products that can reduce environmental impact while meeting food safety and operational requirements.
  
  
Evaluate opportunities to improve the use of utilities and consumable resources, including water, energy and operational materials.
  
  
Engage suppliers and relevant external partners to obtain information on sustainable materials, products and resource-efficient solutions.
  
  
Conduct comparative assessments of proposed solutions and present findings to Management for consideration.
  
  
5. Sustainability Project Management
  
  
Plan and coordinate assigned sustainability projects, including defining project objectives, activities, timelines and expected outcomes.
  
  
Coordinate project activities between Management, Kitchen, Front-of-House, suppliers and external partners.
  
  
Maintain project documentation, implementation records and progress updates for assigned initiatives.
  
  
Identify implementation issues, coordinate follow-up actions and communicate project status to relevant stakeholders.
  
  
Review completed projects against their intended objectives and document outcomes and lessons learned.
  
  
6. Staff Training & SustainabilityCapability
  
  
Develop and conduct staff training and briefing sessions on food waste management, resource conservation and sustainability practices.
  
  
Translate sustainability requirements into practical guidelines and operating instructions for relevant employees.
  
  
Support employees in understanding their responsibilities when implementing sustainability-related practices.
  
  
Gather staff feedback on sustainability practices and identify training or capability gaps.
  
  
Develop internal learning materials and share relevant sustainability knowledge and project lessons with employees.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Understanding of food waste management, resource conservation and sustainable packaging.
  
  
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret operational data, develop KPIs and prepare clear reports.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar data analysis tools; familiarity with inventory management and waste-tracking systems is an advantage.
  
  
Good project management and organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives.
  
  
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Management, kitchen teams, service staff, suppliers and external partners.
  
  
Ability to conduct staff training and translate sustainability goals into practical operating procedures.
  
  
A proactive, hands-on approach to solving problems and implementing improvements.

ING WB Asia Internship Programme 2027

At ING, we're redefining what it means to be a bank, and we're looking for students who are curious, proactive, and eager to make a meaningful impact. About ING Bank

  

We began operating in Singapore in 1987 where we host the regional Asia Pacific headquarters. With over 300 financial experts, we are the largest wholesale banking branch in Asia. ING stands out in the Asia Pacific region because we go a step further for our customers. We look at things from the client’s perspective which allows us to construct tailor-made solutions to fit the needs of every company we serve. This mentality underpins all our client relations and has produced various prestigious awards.

Our internship programme offers more than just on-the-job experience. Through structured onboarding, development initiatives, cross-functional networking opportunities, project showcases and an intern alumni community, you'll gain valuable exposure, build meaningful connections and develop skills for your future career.

  
  

**ING Sustainability Direction**

  
  

Sustainability is a pilar of our strategy and central to our long-term commercial success. The urgent need for a transition to low-carbon economy that balances its impact on nature comes with both opportunities and risks, and it is our ambition to play a leading role in accelerating this transition. That’s why we aim to put sustainability at the heart of what we do.

  
  

**What does Sustainable Solutions Group (SSG) Team do in ING?**

* The Sustainable Solutions Group’s (SSG) mission is to maximise capital flows to our clients and accelerate their sustainable transition, along with the sectors they operate in.

* We translate ING’s sustainability strategy into business opportunities by connecting and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, with a razor-sharp focus on client centricity.

* We deliver sustainability expertise, supported by tooling and data, to provide financing, advice and strategic support to our Wholesale Banking (WB) clients.

SSG holds a global mandate to structure, arrange, and execute transactions with a sustainability characteristic across WB. In addition to supporting origination, SSG structures sustainable products and acts as a strategic partner to clients, offering tailored advice on sustainability and driving innovation in sustainable finance. As ING’s pioneering engine for sustainable finance, SSG plays a leading role in shaping market standards, piloting new instruments, and embedding sustainability into core banking processes.

The SSG APAC covers the Asia Pacific region, with key markets in Australia, Greater China, Japan, Korea, and Philippines.

The team also covers all of ING’s sectors:

* Commodities, Food & Agriculture

* Infrastructure

* Technology, Media, Telecom and Healthcare

* Real Estate

* Transport and Logistics

* Energy

* Financial Institutions

* Corporate Sector Coverage
  

  

**What would you be doing?**

  
  

As an intern you will gain hands-on exposure to sustainable finance transactions and thought-leadership across Asia Pacific. Your responsibilities will include:

* Research and market analysis
  + Conduct market analysis on sustainable finance and other related markets across ING’s Sector portfolio
  + Monitoring market updates and relevant regulatory developments
  + Analyse corporate sustainability disclosure and sector specific developments
* Transaction support and execution
* Assist in origination, structuring, and execution of sustainable finance transactions
  + Prepare pitchbooks and client materials
  + Support development of green, social, sustainable financing frameworks
  + Analyse eligibility of green/social assets
  + Analyse ESG ratings of companies
* Innovation and ad-hoc
  + Prepare conference/seminar/workshop presentation materials
  + Assist with internal trainings to raise awareness and equip colleagues with the skills to drive client dialogue on sustainable finance
  + Contribute to innovative developments such as Circular Economy, Energy Transition, etc
  + Quarterly deal reporting
* Any other sustainability related tasks that may arise
  

  

**What qualities and skills are we looking for?**

  
  

We are looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual who offers the following:

* Undergraduate or postgraduate in any discipline
* Strong interest in leveraging the financial markets to create positive environmental and social impact
* Strong analytical skills, with a high level of attention to detail
* Well-organised, structured, and able to manage multiple tasks
* Motivated, entrepreneurial, and resourceful

Fluent in spoken and written English; knowledge in other Asian languages, in particular Mandarin (preferably)

  
  

**What would you gain from this internship?**

  
  

An exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of the financial markets and on transactions across the green/social debt spectrum (loans, bonds, hybrids) in a wide range of industry sectors as well as being an advocate for a more sustainable world!

description:
ASE is a diverse school focusing on the connections between geosciences, ecology, society and Earth systems. Our approach integrates these disciplines to examine big environmental challenges both in Southeast Asia and globally. We conduct cutting-edge research on topics that include ecology, geohazards, climate change, sea-level rise, environmental sustainability, conservation of environment and biodiversity, and interactions between environment and society. For more information on ASE please visit https://www.ntu.edu.sg/ase .

The Yanyan Cheng research group is seeking a Research Associate. This position is part of a Singapore MOE funded research project hosted by ASE. The Research Associate will help advance research in integrated assessment modeling and understand interactions among land, water, carbon, energy, climate, ecosystems, and human systems.

This is a one-year appointment and potentially renewable based on performance and funding availability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collect, curate, validate, and document large-scale multimodal ecohydrological remote sensing datasets.
* Train and evaluate models on large datasets and high-performance computing systems; establish reproducible baselines, ablation studies, and evaluation suites.
Apply the developed datasets and models to the monitoring and analysis of tropical ecohydrological processes.  

**Job Requirements:**

* The candidate should hold a master's degree in information and communication engineering, with research experience in 3D point-cloud or point-cloud sequence processing, is highly desirable.
* The candidate should posse extensive relevant experience in model design and development, programming implementation, experimental design and evaluation, and peer-reviewed scientific writing.
* The candidate should have demonstrated research expertise in both remote sensing and computer vision.
* The candidate should have a strong publication record. Preference will be given to candidates with first- or co-first-author papers in CCF Rank A computer science venues (e.g., CVPR) and leading peer-reviewed remote sensing journals (e.g., IEEE TGRS).
* The candidate should have strong programming skills in Python and MATLAB, together with practical experience in deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, remote sensing data processing, Linux environments, and high-performance computing.
* The candidate must be able to communicate fluently and demonstrate strong academic writing skills for papers, reports, and presentations.
* The candidate should be able to work independently and collaboratively, manage large datasets and research codebases, meet project deadlines, and produce reproducible research outputs.
Interpersonal skill (e.g. Ability to work independently / develop solutions under strict timelines, meticulous and eye for details / excellent organizational / time management skills).  

ASE seeks a diverse and inclusive workforce and is committed to equality of opportunity. We welcome applications from all and recruit on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
